title: Music Fundamentals
tagline: Learn how music actually works — rhythm, melody, harmony, and a trained ear.
curricula: ABRSM Music Theory Grades 1–3 and aural-skills syllabi
endpoint: from clapping rhythms to hearing how harmony works
about: Music theory and ear training are the grammar of music — how rhythm, melody, and harmony work, and how to hear them working. This category builds musicianship any instrument can use: reading rhythm, singing intervals, understanding scales and chords, and training the ear until written music and heard music become the same language.
